reviews.author: Wende Rabon
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of experiencing Salisbury Towing when the fuel pump went out on one of my cars. I called and told them my situation. They were very polite and asked where I lived and where the car needed to go. The response time and transportation of my car was phenomenal. I would highly recommend using Salisbury Towing if you need a car towed. They are trustworthy and efficient!
